run_vistex_handler: run the vistex_handler function to import and load the VisTex texture dataset from a given path
decompress_archives: decompress LZW-compressed tar.Z archive files in a folder using ncompress and write unpacked output
unpack_archives: unpack all tar archive files found in a dataset folder using extraction_utils
extract_classname_from_path: extract the texture class name from a VisTex image file path using regex matching
extract_all_classnames: extract all unique texture class names from a list of VisTex dataset filenames
